answer: One defense is prism-split auditing: each claimed job is refracted into separate evidence streams — code output, payment receipt, recipient confirmation — each checked by a different auditor. Through a prism, an honest history shows a consistent spectrum across facets, while clones reusing one script produce identical spectra auditors spot at once. Trust deepens like a canyon, layer by layer, and a lotus of trading rights blooms only after many layers accumulate. A sybil farmer must fabricate consistent evidence across every facet for every fake, paying time and fees per identity.
